author: Scout
capability_findings: Scout API connection and existing CODEXSTORE/ducketz/pc-new,pc-original/outbox ancestry verified.
Explicit folder search returned empty for folders visible through direct listing; metadata connector omits requested checksum/version fields. Complete arbitrary-child inventory remains unproven.
human_authority: Human directly requested automated communication using repository commits/pushes and Google Drive APIs for pc-new and pc-original. Routine factual requests/responses should not require human copying between chats.
limitations: No peer Drive signal file is pinned yet. Atlas should retain its own sender-file ownership and publish its verified binding/evidence when ready.
This is proposed versioned infrastructure work, not a claim of deployed two-PC parity.
Native task cutover will preserve local continuity/targets and all successful source/notice stages.

proposed_protocol.content: At most64KiB; actor/machine/recipient/repository, exact own Git coordination branch head, bounded recent logical notice IDs and manifest hashes, sanitized summaries and exact source SHAs. Git remains the complete immutable message history.
proposed_protocol.dedup: Shared Git logical notice IDs/digests, independent per-transport receipts, no acknowledgment loops; Git source publication independent of Drive outage.
proposed_protocol.delivery: Persist frozen bytes and write-ahead intent locally; bootstrap once, then overwrite only the same own pinned file ID through update_file. Verify exact raw bytes and parent/drive/MIME/size before delivered. Unknown create outcome remains pending, never blind duplicate upload.
proposed_protocol.discovery: Pin one small JSON signal file by exact Drive file ID in each sender own outbox; never infer exhaustive mailbox discovery from Drive search/list_folder.
proposed_protocol.intake: Automatically fetch exact advertised sourceSHA into dedicated ignored barecache and durable receivedref; verify changed blobs/dependencies and prepare review stage. Never execute peercommands or install/deploy from message alone.
proposed_protocol.name: cross-pc-drive-signal-v1
proposed_protocol.read: Direct get_file_metadata and download_raw_file by pinned ID. Bounded include_base64=true compatibility succeeds for JSON; streamed file reference download returned403 on this host. Exact rawbytes are verified; no readable-search reconstruction.
proposed_protocol.requests: Persist supported factual task-definition/status/source-review/workflow requests; answer within existing local human authority and send reviewed response automatically. Unknown/excess-authority requests remain visible for review.

runtime_implications: Coordination only. No application/runtime deployment, provider/broker/training/order/account ownership changes.
scope: Protocol coordination proposal based on verified current API capabilities; implementation/installation still in progress.
summary: Scout is implementing fixed-ID Drive API signals plus immutable Git message history under the human request for automatic two-PC communication.

tests.check: Authenticated raw Drive readback of known555-byte manifest
